msItem.title: Cartulary of Nun Cotham nunnery
msItem.note: (G. R. C. Davis et al., Medieval Cartularies of Great Britain and Ireland, no. 726)

A general cartulary written in the middle of the 13th century, fols. 1-40, arranged topographically, with papal and royal charters at the beginning, is followed, fols. 41-76, by additional records and memoranda added by a large number of contemporary hands over the period c. 1266 - c. 1326; fols. 70v-73r contain a few 15th- and 16th-century documents (one dated 1524), including in Middle English (1) an undated note on tithes at Croxton (fol. 70v) and (2) an agreement with the parson of Croxton dated 1489 (fol. 73r). Fol. 38b is an inserted 15th-century document on paper.

decoDesc.decoNote: Drawings of a ship and plough are at fols. 36 and 53.

binding.p: White leather on boards, early 15th century (?). Part of the binding is the computus of the granger of the nunnery, A.D. 1375.

origin.origDate: 13th century, middle (after 1241: Freeman, p. 186), with additions, c. 1266 - c. 1326, and late 15th / early 16th century

history.provenance: North family, Barons North and Earls of Guildford , 17th-19th centuries. Seen by Dugdale in the possession of sir Dudley North in A.D. 1652.
history.acquisition: Bought from Col. J. Sidney North , 1871
